$note: Literals that are deliberately not translated. Each entry is "file:kind:value", so moving the string to another file or changing a character brings it back for review instead of grandfathering it silently. Adding to this list is a decision somebody makes in a pull request; the scanner never writes to it on its own except through --allow, which is for bootstrapping.

$reasons.brand names: The product's own name is the same in every language, and a <title> element is read by the browser before any catalogue could load.
$reasons.acronyms and format names: CSV and SSO are the same three letters in Spanish, English and Portuguese. Translating them would be inventing a local name for something nobody calls anything else.
$reasons.the noscript message: It appears only when JavaScript is off, which is exactly when there is no i18n runtime to ask. All three languages are written out side by side instead — the one place in this product where that is the correct answer rather than a shortcut.
